name: android-emulator-profile
description: Prepare Android emulators for runs and tests, with profile-based SDK/AVD setup and read-only status previews.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare Android emulators for runs and tests; inspect status.
interface.longDescription: Reuses suitable emulators or AVDs for Android runs and tests, prepares SDK tools and profiles when needed, and provides read-only status and screen previews. Bundled helpers support profile-based local and Docker-friendly setup.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a suitable Android emulator for this project's tests.
Show the Android emulator status panel.
